modalityRule: No silhouette IoU is claimed because the user screenshot uses different artwork and a different visible contour.

nearestRiveFrame.label: USER-SCREENSHOT NEAREST
nearestRiveFrame.basis: roll, opposite-edge ratios and width/height signature; identity pixels excluded

roll.evidence: Two root layers author −16.652° and +26.858° screen rotations, both converging to 0° over frames 0–29.

yaw.evidence: Slab-rotate-v01 translates side sprites; Coin_Slab_v09-sm deforms 2D mesh vertices; runtime frames show front/edge/reverse/front.

pitch.evidence: The user screenshot has foreshortening, but no 3D pitch channel exists; sprite substitution and 2D homography can produce the same raster.

threeDimensionalAxis.evidence: The canonical Rive format exposes 2D x/y/rotation/scale, masks and remaps, not Euler or quaternion axes.
